paper_title: New axion and hidden photon constraints from a solar data global fit
coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing chi, computed as chi = (1.8e-12 eV)/m from the paper's stated bound chi*m < 1.8e-12 eV
notes: Paper (arXiv:1501.01639, Vinyoles et al. 2015) performs a global fit to helioseismology + solar neutrino data. Two new limits: (1) hidden photon kinetic mixing chi*m < 1.8e-12 eV at 3-sigma (emitted here as the DarkPhoton result per hint; limit stated to be most stringent from 3e-5 eV to 8 eV, formally valid for m << 0.3 keV via resonant longitudinal-mode emission); data_points constructed analytically as chi = 1.8e-12/m over the paper's stated dominance range. (2) Also derives axion-photon g_agamma < 4.1e-10 GeV^-1 at 3-sigma (mass-independent for light ALPs), not encoded here since only one coupling type can be returned. Stated CL is 3-sigma (~99.7%), stricter than the 0.95 recorded.
